name: Tanrei
description: The default design system. Near-monochrome surfaces, a monochrome primary and one accent. It takes its values from core and leaves out the components and variants it does not draw.

segmented-button.reason: One choice among several is told by what it changes: tabs where it switches the content below, radio buttons where it sets a value, a button group where each button toggles on its own.

fab-menu.reason: The default system draws no floating action button; its main action opens a sheet of further actions.
